description: This file defines the 'I18NGroup' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_i18n_group' database table. It includes properties for 'id', 'name', and 'title', along with their respective getter and setter methods, using Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.
